name: We Carry the Fire
source:
"The Empire is dying. Everyone knows it; they just won't talk about it. Every time the red moon comes, the shades wipe out more towns and villages, and thousands of people die. It's only getting worse. The way things are going, I wouldn't be surprised if next time they breach the walls of one of the free cities, and maybe then we'll all finally be ready to admit the truth: it's over for us.

But maybe not even then. I tell you, these people are in such denial. You know what they say? They say, 'Have faith. God will save us.' Will He? I'm not so sure. In fact, I think He's made it pretty clear He does not give a damn about us. He could've saved us centuries ago. Why the wait? To test us? C'mon, let's be serious now. The first red moon came, and what did He do? He gave us Fire. He said, 'Here, this'll protect you.' And then - poof! - He vanished. Hasn't been heard from since. He left us. Left us to fend for ourselves. That's what people don't realize. That is the thought they will not let themselves have.

And, listen, it's not like I don't get it. It's hard to admit you've been abandoned. It's more comforting to believe there's someone out there who cares about you, who'll show up in your time of need. But there isn't. There's no one. It's just us. The sun is going down, and all we got here at the end of the day is each other. So, I guess that'll have to do."

We Carry the Fire is a visual novel set in a world that is slowly ending. Every few years after the new moon disappears from the night sky, it will return red, and when that red moon is full every town, village, and city in the Empire will be attacked by spectral monsters called Shades. The only weapon the people have in their defense is Fire, an ever-burning white flame believed to be a gift from God Himself.

Players follow Ashe, a young person whose red eyes mark him as an outcast. When a new red moon appears, Ashe volunteers to deliver Fire to a remote farming village that would otherwise be destroyed under the full moon. This mission will be particularly dangerous because it requires him to cross the Forest, a mysterious wilderness believed to be home to spirits and monsters of myth.

But Ashe will not face these dangers alone. He is joined by a party of other outcasts like himself: Blaise a former knight excommunicated from her order for an alleged heresy; Kol, an Alfar of the Forest exiled from his clan for breaking a taboo; and Luz, a magical prodigy expelled from her university for stealing secrets from restricted texts.

The trials they encounter in their journey will push each of them to their breaking point, and to overcome them they must face things they had tried to keep in the past.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2408090/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
“帝国正在消亡。所有人都知道，只是不愿说出口。每当红月来临，阴影怪物就会摧毁更多城镇与村庄，数千人死去。情况只会越来越糟。照这样下去，就算下次它们攻破某座自由城市的城墙，我也不会惊讶。也许直到那时，我们才终于愿意承认真相：我们完了。

可也许，即便如此，他们也不肯。我跟你说，这些人就是不愿面对现实。你知道他们怎么说吗？他们说：‘要有信心。上帝会救我们。’他会吗？我不太确定。事实上，我觉得他已经说得很明白：他根本不在乎我们。他几百年前就能救我们。为什么要等？考验我们？得了吧，认真点。第一次红月出现时，他做了什么？他给了我们圣火。他说：‘拿着，它会保护你们。’然后——噗！——他消失了。从此再无音讯。他抛下我们，任我们自生自灭。这就是人们不明白的事，也是他们不允许自己产生的念头。

听着，也不是说我不理解。承认自己被抛弃，很难。相信远方还有人关心自己，会在需要时现身，当然更令人安心。可没有。谁也没有。只有我们。太阳正在落下，到头来，我们所拥有的，只有彼此。所以，我想，也只能这样了。”

《We Carry the Fire》是一部发生在缓慢走向终结的世界中的视觉小说。每隔几年，新月从夜空消失后，再度出现时便会染成红色。当红月满盈，帝国中的每座城镇、村庄与城市，都会遭到名为“阴影”的幽灵怪物袭击。人们唯一的防御武器，是“圣火”：一种永不熄灭的白色火焰，被认为是上帝亲自赐予的礼物。

玩家将跟随阿什，一位因红色双眼而遭到排斥的年轻人。当新的红月出现，他自愿将圣火送往偏远的农耕村庄，否则，村庄将在满月之下毁灭。这项任务格外危险，因为他必须穿越“森林”——一片神秘的荒野，据说栖息着灵体与神话怪物。

但阿什不会独自面对危险。与他同行的，是其他同样遭到排斥的人：布莱丝，因被指控信奉异端而遭骑士团除名的前骑士；科尔，因触犯禁忌被逐出族群的森林精灵；以及露兹，因从禁阅文献中窃取秘密，被大学开除的魔法天才。

旅途中遭遇的考验，将把每个人逼向极限。为了克服它们，他们必须面对那些曾试图留在过去的事。
